name: codex-scientific-diagram-visio
description: Reconstruct scientific paper figures as editable SVG/AI/PDF and build verified native Microsoft Visio model diagrams.

interface.shortDescription: From paper evidence to editable scientific figures.
interface.longDescription: Audit papers, source data, model code, and legacy figures; reconstruct editable SVG, Illustrator AI, editable PDF, or native Visio outputs; and bind delivery to reproducible evidence and publication gates.
capabilities: Diagram prompting and visual reference generation
Paper PDF figure inventory and hybrid vector reconstruction
Reviewed OCR cleanup and Illustrator roundtrip evidence
defaultPrompt: Audit my model and prepare a verified diagram contract.
Rebuild this architecture as an editable Visio figure.
Repair overlaps and connectors in this VSDX.
Reconstruct this paper figure as editable SVG, AI, and PDF with an evidence-backed publication gate.
